nhakwonho hi'a ntuwehselvki nahski iyuhsti khilo tikowhelihski kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ukvwlhi akeyhonvhi tsikehso'i nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanel tsitotikananukowhihsko tsukvwalhohti uhskwanikhoht tsutalenhvtv titse ale tsuwethi
hi'akhani tinehskehski uwetsi melikhni utsi alekhani analhinvtli tsimi ale tsohsi ale hsawani ale tsutahsi'
alekhni tsuto nikatv ehskanhi tsaneha' katonho ulhstohthanv hi'a nikatv tsuweha'
hi'anho nituwehsele tsunvhsitahsti hi'a nahski tsani titawehski to'ulenhv tsuyohuhsvki ale nahski iyuhsti uhskwanikhotiyu tsitulvwhstaneha
elotvyhenho uniyvhe tsani ale ulhvle'i ale uhstunhe titahstutiyi kwiliki elot tinatanhvlhi utali'i elotihsi tsuto'itv uhstvtihske'i
tsanyhen hi'a nuwehsele elotv vlha tuyukohtv yki nahski tsatayheha
ale utulihske uhihstiyi ahsenho tahska'ihe yvwi atolehohskiyenho uniyelhse tsani
nahski iyuhsti uhselithane uthu'ihstanele unhehtiy nuhstvkwo uthayohlv'i
ukvwhiyuhinho uyo'iyu uyelvnhe'i ahsenho uhselithanv'i ale nahskwo nahski analhstayvhvhski nvtsulhstohthane'i unhetse atsinehtiyi
uhskonho uniyholhe athelitokihi ale uninhele athv nahskinho utsi wunhele'i
kvwahstawatitohinho uniluhtse ale uninehse ayelv'i ale uninihsanhe'i ale unenvhse wninhonhele tsihsa
tsihsanho uthvkanv tsiyu utsothanvki nanha unikihsvki utayelilv inake wulohsvki nhkwonho yvwi unahthvkanv elati kvwhstawatv'eki tekatuhv totayunenvhsvki
tsihsanho utsa'ihsv tukohvki unitsathi yvwi al tuwetolitsvki ale tunhvwanvtsunitlvki

uhsvnho nulhsthanv kvwahstawatohi kvwaluhtselki hi'a nuniwehsvki anhi inakekwo ale ika ulohsonit tsitsenkwon khiyohsi hi'a unitsathi yvwi ale totikatuhv wi'anilohi nanha unvhsv unalhstayhvhti uniwhsvha
ahseno tsihsa hi'a nituwehselki vlha ahse v'unenvhsti yiki nhikwo titselhsta
hi'anho nvkwawehselki anhi hihskikwo katu tokiha thalikwonho atsa'ti
hi'anho nuwehsvki anhi tihskiyohihsi
nikatvnho unalhstayvnhvki ale tunolhvhsvki ale unuthihsvki ulikvhaluyhvhi uthiyvhi thalatu iyakhali'i thalutsa
unalhstayvnhinho hihskiha iyakayvli anihskaya nani'vki nitanhelhvhtvna anikeyhv ale tiniyolhi
khilakwonho iyvt tsihsa tunvwhsthanvki kvwahstawatitohi tsiyuhi unatsotiyi ale ikvyi nitunihsohihstiyi ahsi tayhelihihstihskv unitsathi
nhakwonho tuyelihihsthanv unitsathi otalv unhaluhsvki uwahsv kehsv'i utatolihsthanvhsvki uhsnho nulhsthan nanha uwahskwo kehsvki
ahsenho khilakwo iyvtv tsihsa tunhetselvki hi'a nituwehselvki ukalhstikwo itsatanhvhtta ayvkwoyhenho lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti
kwitanho unetsv hi'a nuwehselvki tsakvwiyuhi iyunho nihi kehsehsti hskinetsi wikvluhtsetiyi amayi katu'i
ehena utvnhvki nhakwonho kwit tsiyuhi utsa'ihsv amayi katu'i a'ihsvki tsihsa tsetohv wakhahthvki
ahsenho ntolehohsv ahstayiyu kanolv'vhskv uhskalvki ale ulenvhv kanoyvkv uwelhunhvki tsakvwiyuhi hskihstelv utvnhvki
tsiyuhinho i'unatsanv kanolv'vhskv uhsulkotsvki
nhakwonho tsiyuhi unatsa'i uniluhtsv kvwatatolihstanelvki hi'a nuniwehsvki utohiyuhiy nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi
nhakwonho tunihsohtsv kenihsilati uniluhtsvki
nanhnho anehi anihskaya kvwolhihtsv kvwathuwitv tunatanvhsitolvki tkvwahthinohelvki nikatv tsunitlvki
ahsenho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki katonho nahskwo nihi ethi anehi uninhohelhi itstihsko itsiyohstihsko unelhanvhi unhetsvhi'
unelhanvhiyhenho unhetse hi'a nuwehse'i hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsi ale nahskwo hi'a khilo tahskinvtihskehsti utota ale utsi ahse uyohuhihsti kehsehsti
ahsenho nihi hi'a nitsiwehsko'i iyunho khilo hi'a nikawehsehehsti utota ale utsi akwalhskolthanvhi yeli ketsalhstelhvhtohti kehsv'i nitsatvnehv
itsatlonahsti yelikwo ihsaya tsutolehohse tsitsitvke'i hi'a tsinuwehse'i
hi'a yvwi na'v kvkiluhtseha aniholi antiha ale tunihanekalv tanhvhti kvkilvkwohtiha ahseno uninawhi invhiyu nunvnhv

nhakwonho kvwhstawatitohi uniluhtsv hi'a nikwhselvki hikhahthhahsko anikwalihsi uninhalvtsv'i unathvkanv nahski hi'a nitsawehsv'i

kwitanho unetsv hi'a nuwehselki tihskiyohsihsahsi hi'a nahski talhilohstv'i
lahsko ahsi yitsolhihka nahski nika'v kohuhsti vholi uyvhsthanvhi kehsv ohskwolhiyi wikaluhkv'i nahskino wkalohihstihskvkwo'
nahskini vholi nvtayunukotsvhi onawiyi titalehvhsko'i nahskinho kataha nuwaneho yvwi
nahskihskini hi'a kataha iywanehi yvwi nitahsulehvnahskini alhstayvtiyi vlha kataha yinuwaneho yvwi
tsihsano nanha unhikihsv thayo'i ale hsatoniyi wulohsvki
khvnhiyukwonho kenani ehi akeyhv nanha na'v nvtayulohsvhi uwelhunhvki hi'a nuwehselki hskitoliki tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi akwetsi akeyhv utsathanvhi uteyhahthohtiha ahskina
ahsenho nunhetselvnakwo vkehsvki kvwhstawatitohinho kvwaluhtselvki kvwahthayohselvki hi'a nuniwehsvki w'ena ikihskonhihayhenho
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehsvki vlha yituyukhohti tiki'ehtiyi tiniyolhi untseli katu klhinho witatinhetiyi
akeyhvn hi'a nuwehsvki utohiyuhi tsakvwiyuhi ahsenho kilhi analhstayvhthsko unko'ohsvhi tikvwaninalha'i tunihskilv'i

unitsathino yvwi kvwaluhtselvki tanahthinehv tiniyo'ulhi ale tinikhewi ale tsunvkhewi al kohuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi ale unitsathi nvwanatle'i ale tsihs tulahskv na'v tuninvnvki tunwanvkinho

nahski iyuhsti unitsathi kehsv unihskwanikohsvki tunikohv tsunvkhewi aniwonihsk'i ale ahuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi uninhohstv nunalhsthanv'i al ttiyo'ulhi kvwanetahsti nulhsthanv'i ale tinikhewi kvwanikowhahthvhti nulhsthanv'i unilvkwohthanvkinho unelhanvhi ihsili unatselika
kvwahstawatitohinho hi'a nvkvwwehselvki hatlvnho yotsiki nahski ika'i alhstayvhti inake'i nahski iynitsathi yeli tsunolhihsti'
tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki ilako katu tetsiyheha' kalhikwoki ilvhskinho tsunhsti atsa'ti unatvnhvki
anikwalihsinho ale anihsatuhsi uniluhtsvki kvwakoliyehskvnho kvwahthayohselvki tsunanukowhsehtiyi uyelhvhtv kalvlati nvtayulohsvhi
unhetsvn hi'a nituwehselvki uhsvnikalhsta hi'a nitsiwehsko'i ulvhklyihst kehsehsti kalvloyhenho kikak'iyu iki

snalenho tsikehso'i kohi ika tsiki tvkanhani kalvloyhenho kikak'iyu iki ale ikalokiliyeha itsatihsko'i itsatlonahsti yelikwo itsatlhohsko nuhstv kalvlo'i lhahskonho yeli ketsatolehohihsti yiki uyelhvhtv iyu lhsthanitahsti kehsv'i'
kvwahstawatitohino tunihsohtsv unvkhewhsvhi kehsvki unatenhohtiyi
tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki itseyhahthhehsti aktohti anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi unatselika
uninhelhvkinho kehsv unvhsv hi'a nuniwehsvki nikatenhvna tsiki nvtikalhstohtiha
tsihsanho nahski utolehohsv hi'a nituwehselvki uhsti itsohiyuhi katonho itsvhsv kehsv itsinheha alhstayvhti nitsiyhehvna kehsv'i'
kato tikalhstohti nitsolhihkvna tsiki nahski hi'a tsinitsvwehsi lhahskini katu yitsitvka itseyhahthahehsti aktohti anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi unatselika tsitsvyohsi'
nhakwonho unoltsvki nuninhetsehvna kehsv uneyhahtho'ihstiyi katu akohtohti tanateyhvhskvhskini anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi
hi'ano nituwehselvki nihinanho kako hskiyohseha'

nhakwono tsihsa ulenvhvki tunonhelvki kvwhstawatitohi ahse uwenvhstiyi kehsv tsiluhslmi ale tsutalenhvtv tsukilhiyotsehtiyi tinilawiki ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinowelihski ale atsi'ihstiyi ale tso'ine ika tsulehtiyi
nhakwonho tsihsa hi'a nituwehselvk kvwhstawatitohi iyunho khilo utulihskehsti akhstwatvhstiyi atatahyihehsti uwahsv ale tsutanhawtv ayihskehsti ale akhstawatekehsti
sutalnho wnuhsvlhv tsihsa tuthinhsvki kwita ale tsimi al tsani tsimi tinatanhvlhi ale tunhalhuhthanvki inv ikathi otalv unvhsv kehsv'i
ale khvnhiyukwo nanha khvnikehsv nikvwantvnhele mohsi ale ilaya kvwalhinohehtihske'i

ahsikwonho kawonihske'i khvnhiyukwo uhskohstv ulokila unatawatihsthane'i ale khvnhiyukwo nanha ulokilv tsunhetse'i hi'a nvtsuwehse'i hi'a nahski akwetsi tsikeyu'i nahski ohsiyu tsiyelv'i nahski etsathvtahstanehehsti
kvwhstawatitohinho unathvkanv tuninvtse tuniyhahstuhse'i utsathi unihskale'i
tsihsanho uluhtse tuhsvnhile'i hi'a nuwehse'i titsalehvka ale lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti
tunakhnhannho vlha khilo yunikohe tsihsa uwahsv
tsunikhso'ahsitihsvnho otalv'i tsihsa tunvhstatele'i hi'a nuwehse'i lhehsti khilo etsinonhelvha nahski tsitsikowhathv khvnhi yvwi uwetsi uyohuhsv tulenhehsti
nhakwonho kvwahstawatitohi unoltse tsani titawohski khane'ihstihskv'i
nhkwonho unitsathi anetohv uniluhtsv uluhtselki ahskaya tulhinikwanvnelvki hi'a nuwehsvki
tsakvwiyuhi hiyatoliki atshutsa akwetsi kliyenho kvwahiha ale utsathi akilhiyoka yanokiyuyhenho atsilvyi khvtko'i ale amayi akvko'i
katsiyathinhelvkinho ketsahstawatitohi ahsenho uninulvnhvki uninhvwotiyi
tsihsanho ahskina uhskatsvki ahskinanho unukotsvki atshutsa ale nahiyukwo utiwhsvki
hi'ahskininhonv iyuhsti vlha unuko'ihsti yiki khvnhi yvtatolihstiha ale amalhi yakvhska
ahsinho kelili anetohv'i tsihsa hi'a nituwehselvki yvwi uwetsi yvwi totaketsiyohihseli

kekwaninho uniluhtsv ayelhi atelv ankihsitohi kvwaluhtsele kwita hi'a nuniwehse'i lahsko titseyhohvhski ayelhi yakhuyihsko'i'

tsihsanho ayolhi wuyhanvhv ayelhi aninv uwekhanhvki ale hi'a nuwehsvki
utohiyhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha iyunho nitsatanetliyvhsvna ikehsehsti al tiniyolhi tsinunahsti nitsalhsthanvna ikehsehsti vlha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv yvketsiyvha
ale khilo tatanilvkehsti hsakwo nahski hi'a iyuhsti ayolhi takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti ayv takwatanilvkehsti
khilohskini tkotehstihskehsti hsakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv nahski kvkwohiyuhvhski utli ohsiyu ahstohski nvya yatsiyalhanv ale ahstvkv amekwohi yatsikvyhv
yvwiyhenho uwetsi uluhtsv uhstelvhilv ulenalhvhi
nahskiya nahskwo vlha yutuli itsitota kalvlati ehi hsakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv tsuniyohuhihstiyi
iyunho tihstatanhvtlhi itshskanvtsehehsti hekehsti hinonhehehsti uhskanvtsv ihstvhskwo kehsv'i iyunho itsathvtahstanehehsti hiwahthvhehsti tihstatanhvlhi
iyuhskininho nitsathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti ahsiyvwi ale anithali tehahthinekehsti nahskinho aninohehskv anithali ale anitso'i anikhahthahi nikatv tshanetsv ahstayohskehsti

iyunho nahski nitathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti tsunanelhohti unatalhuhkv hinhohvhskehsti iyuhskinino tsunanelhohti unatalhuhkv nitathvtahstanehvna ikehsehsti nvwatalekwo yvwi ale ayelhikwo'atelv akihsitohi nahskiya hiyatanvthehskehsti
alewo hi'a nitsvwehseha iyunho anithali nihi tsitsetoha analikohvhskehsti anhi elohi nika'vkwo kohuhsti anithayohihehsti nahski iyunatvnhehti kehsehsti etota kalvlati ehi
nhakwonho kwta uluhtselv hi'a nuwehsvki tsakvwiyuhi ilako nakhskanvtsehehsti tsohstatanhvlhi ahsikwo itsiyatolikehsti' kalhihkwokihsko'

nahski iyuhsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo kilo ukvwiyuhi tsutanthelhe ohstv iyunvnhehtiyi tuthukv tsunvhsitahsti
nhkwonho unalenvhv ohstv nunvnelv hsakwo akathinhele ahskohi iyukwatinvtv atelv uthuki
nahski iyuhsti atsinvhsitahsti elati utanvne'i ale utatolihstanele'i hi'a nuwehse'i hskinalha'i hskitoliki hskikhahthita nikatvnho takvyakuyv'eli
nahskinho atsinvhsitahsti unalha'i uwetolitse'i ale uwekhanhe'i ale uthukv unelaki uwelihsele'i
itsulahanho ketsinvhsitahsti tulahskv elati utanvne utatolihstanele'i hi'a nuwehse'i hskitoliki hskikhahthita nikatvnho takvyakyv'eli

unetsvnho hi'a nituwehselvki lhahsko yitsikoliye'o nahski titalenihskv tsuwelhvnhvhi ahskaya ale akeyhv tuwolhvnhv'i'
ale hi'a nuwehsv'i nahski iyuhsti ahskaya tekvhtekehsti utota ale utsi ale atlawhstihskehsti utali'i ale nahski anithali hsakwokwo unikwetalhv'i'
nahski iyuhsti vlha nhakwo anithali yiki hsakwokwohskini unikwetalhv'i nahski iyuhsti unelhanvhi tsuwuhthathanvhi kehsv lhsti yvwi y'itukalenhvhthanehsti
hi'ano nituwehselvki tihstayiyu kehsv iyuhst titsinawhi mohsi unanelaki tanikhetohihehsti tsunatali'i itselihselvki titalnihskvhskini vlha nahski yinuhste'i
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha khilo utali'i i'akhitohehsti tsunhsinvhihskininonv ikehsehsti nvwtalenho i'atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti khilonho atsikhehitolvhi atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti
kvwahstawatitohi hi'a nikvwawehselvki iyunho nahski yinuhsti ahskaya utali'i tanatsehv'i vlha ohsiyu yiki atehsvhvhstiyi

tuhsithatvnho nanha utanvhsvki
khvnhiyukwonho ahsiyvwi uluhtselvki hi'a nuwehselvki hohstv thateyhohvhski kato uhsti ohstv kohuhsti takatvneli akhiwathvhtohti wnahstvna kvnhitv'
hi'an nuwehselvki katonho hohstv ihskwohseha' vlha khilo ohstv yiki hsakwo uwahsvhiyu nahski unelhanvhi ahsenho tsatulihskehsti kvnhitv tikehsv wtsananuko'ihstiyi thihskwanikota tikhanhawatvhsti
hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsi ale nahskwo hi'a tsvhsv nitsatakeyuhsv nikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala
kvwhstawatitohinho unathvkanv utsathanvhi unihskwanikohsvki hi'a nuniwehsvki kakonho yeli yatsihstelv'
tsihsanho nahski tukhanhnv hi'a nituwehselvki yvwi kehsv vlha nahski yinvkalhsta unelhanvhihskini kehsv nika'v kohuhsti iyulhstohtikwo
nhkwono kwita unhetsv hi'a nuwehselvki khvnhiyukwo ayv nikatiyu tokiyohsonhv ale itsvhstawatenv katonho ayv tayotsiwhahthvhi'

tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha atanetliyvhsv'i yvwi uwetsi kanhvha kalvkwotiyu uwehskilv'i nihi hskihstawatvtv nahskwo itsinehsti thaltu tkahskilv'i tetsukhohtanehehsti thaltu nanilhstalhv ihsli

ale nani'v khilo tsunttsvhi taninelv'i ale analhinvtli ale tsunito ale tsunitota ale tsunitsi al tsunatali'i al tsunetsi al katohi takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti uniwhahthvhti kehsehsti ahskohitskwi unekwotsvhi ale unatseli iyulhstohti kehsehsti kvnhitv winahstvna
ahsenho unitsatha ikvyi tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti onhiyinho tsiki ikvyi'ikehsehsti
kalvlatiyhenho utselikohi nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela hsnal'iyu tsuwenvhse tsitunvhsvhse kohuhsti anatvnehi thelvlati tuwhsv tsunilvwhstantiyi
nhakwonho nahski ahskaya kohuhsti anatvnehi tunukhohthanv akihsi tsukvwalhohti tskyv'ehtiy hsika thelvlati totsuwhsv tunvhse'i
ale hi'a nituwehsel'i itsenha nahskwo nihi thelvlati totiwihsv'i tuyukhohthvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyv'eli unenvhsenho
thaline ika i'uwenvhse ale nahskwo tso'ine iyulhilotv khalawatihsv uhsvhiyeyi nahskiya ni'utvnele'i
hihskinenho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv thaline i'uwenvhse'i ale tuwhahthvhe nvwanatale anitona'e kohuhsti nanatvnehvna hi'ano nituwehsel'i katonho ani itsitona'a utotakwatv kohuhsti nitsatvnehvna'
layhenha khilo yokinvhsv unatvnhe'i hi'ano nituwehsel'i nihi nahskwo itsena thelvlati totiwhsv'i tuyukhohthvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyv'eli
hihskinnho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv anihsiywha akihsi tsukvwalhohti kekakyv'ele'i
kkkyv'elvnho uniknlohihselekwo ahskaya kanela
hi'a nuniwehse'i hi'a onhiyi uniluhtsvhi hsakwokwo iyulhilotv tunilvwhstahsi itsulahakwonho nhskiyvka ayv nahski kakehsv ale utilhekv ika tsokilvwhstanelvhi
ahsenho ahsiyvwi unhetsele hi'a nuwehsele'i kinali'i vlha utsathini ynikvyvneha lahsko ohsi yitsayelvnhe akihsi tsukvwalohti kvyakyv'ehtiyi'
hiki tsatselika ale tsihena ohsi akiyelv tsiyakyv'ehtiyi hi'a onhiyi uluhtsvhi nihi kvykyv'elv ika'i
howanho onhiyi tsiki ikvyi kehsehsti ikvyinho tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti unitsahthayhenho ketsiyanvhv ahsenho anikayolhiyu kekahsuyehsv
tsihsanho tsiluhslmi wakahthv'i thalatu iyanitv anatahstawatitohi unnelki iyvtv wituthinhvhsthanvki ale hi'a nituwehselvki
hi'ano nuwehselvki kato tsatuliha' hi'a nvtayuwehselvki halhskolhvta hi'a anithali tikwetsi tsunihtiyi tsatselikohi kehsv'i hsakwo hikhahthihsi itilv hso'ino hikhskani

nihihskini lhehsti nahski yinitsvhnehsti khilohskini atsilvkwoti iylhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti

nhakwonho ukvwiyuhi hi'a nitotakawehseli akthihsi itilv anitona'i etsena etota itsilvkwohthanvhi itsatseli winikalhsta utselikohi etsalihskoltanelvhi elohi tsutolhvnhv nvtakvwatalenvtv

ilakiyu itsvko'e netsakahthahvna itsvyvthanenho ale tsaylvha kehse'i itsvnuwo'enho
ale ilakiyu itsvko'e tsatlvke'i ale titahstutiyi etsahstuhe'i itsvykathanilhe'nho'
ukvwiyuhinho takhanetsi hi'a nitotakawehseli utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha nahskiyhenho tsinetsatvnhelv uhstikhani hi'a nahski otsalhinvtli ayv nihskiyatvnhelvki
hi'ano nahskwo nitotakawehseli akhskani itilv anitona'i hskiyatanvhsi etsihskatsvhi wnahstvna atsilv'yi tikehsv witsilohi nahski ahskina ale tsutseli tinikhanhwtitohi kekolhvnanelvhi

uninhelheno kalonuhetv unhvhtohtiyi uniniytiyi tsihsa ale unihihstiyi
ahsenho hi'a nuniwehse'i lhehsti tilhstayvhtiyi kehsv'i nahiyuyhenho yiki utsathi yanalihthelvhvka yvwi
tsihsanho kwetiniyi etohv'i hsawani atayhehski utlvki kanelv'i

uyoyhenho iyunatvnhatki nikohilv ketselatitoha ayvhskini vlha nikohilv ytsvyelatitoha
hi'ayhenho atloneti tsiyelv'i tskiloneta vkinihsohtiyi akwatvn'ihstiha

kwitanho hi'a nuwehselvki nahskwo itsulaha tiyiniyohuhihsti yki ahse vlha yvkakvyatayika nahskiya nahskwo nikatv kvwahstawatitohi nahski nuniwehsvki
nhakwonho tsihsa ale kvwhstawatitohi uniluhtsvki kehsimini tuto'v'i hi'ano nituwehselv kvwhstawatitohi anhi itsinehsti khvnhi itlv wiktatolihsthanvha
ti'uluhtsvnho tuwhahtvhe thaline anilhina'e'i tinikahtholiyhenho tikaketiyu kehse'i

ale khvnhiyukwo ahsiyvwi tsihsa anehi uhsaltnvki khanokeni ulvhvki ayelhstikanvhitv ale uluyhv ukvwiyuhi atsilvkelhi unvhsitahsti ale ulihstehsthanvki
nhakwno tsihsa hi'a nuwehselvki kalatihstiyi tsihilt tsatseli ayelhstikanvhitv nikatvyhenho ayelhstikanvhitv aniyihski aylhstikanvhitv tsuniyohuhihstohti kehsehsti
nhkwonho unalhvlv unelihsanawitvhe'i kwanitv kwaleti ukvwiyuhi wtuniyohihsele'i
ale tutinv atelv nanha tikalawi'ihstiyi ale unukotse'i ale iyvtv wulohsv uwahsv wutatvne'i
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv'anelhi tunikihsv atelv hi'a nuniwehse'i vlha tuyukhohtv ykaki atelvtihtiyi yititihvhska kikyhenho tsukvwlhanvhi

ale uniwahihsthanvki vthi tikolhvhski ulokehsv'i nahskiya yhowa akwyhonhv'i
tsihsanho ktoke ikvytitlv ukvwiyuhi uwolhv'i ukvwiyuhinho uthvtvnhe'i hi'a nuwehse'i nihihsko tsakvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika' tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i yeliniwi
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv'anelhi ale tinilawiki kvwayhilitolv vlha yunhetse'i

nahiyunho tikanotsalhi ayhvki unikhhe kwalakwa tsuto'itv
akahthaheynho anvyuhkhvkwo nvtikalhstohtihskv tuniyohsv'i

ale kvnhiyukwo utsathi katohi ulihthelvnhe'i yihowayhenho utseli tikhanhawatitohi kalvlati tsulo'ahse'i uluhtsvnho nvya uwehsakwalelhe uhvhse kalohihstiyi ahv'i ale uhskilhane'i
